_doc: Built-in API client conformance (SPEC §7G.9, §7G.5, §7G.11). A port's harness, per case: starts the fake HTTP server (script[] in order, last repeats; entries {status, body|rawBody|bodyBase64, headers?}), substitutes {server} everywhere (config, args, script bodies and headers, expectations), makes {dir} (passed as gather.dir) and {inputs} (writes inputFiles name->base64 there), sets env and removes unsetEnv, builds the named built-in client (client = a2e|elevenlabs|openai|openrouter|fal) from config, and calls createMedia(client) for verb/args through the function face and then the tool face (fresh script replay, fresh {dir}). Asserts: expectRequests in order (method, path exactly as sent incl. query; body = JSON deep-equal; multipart = parts in order, each {name,value} or {name,filename,contentType,bytesBase64}; headers = subset with exact values; absentHeaders = must not be sent) — when expectRequests is present the request count must match too; expectHeaders on EVERY request; expectProgress; result (files: url/data/type/mimeType exact; saved = file lives directly in {dir}, name matches ^<client>-<verb>-[0-9]+-[0-9]+<ext>$, path absolute, url == 'file://'+path, bytes == bytesBase64) or error (exact) / errorPrefix (startsWith) with status; tool: output exact or outputPattern (regex after substituting {dir} regex-escaped), parts, metadata, noParts = no parts key. liveVerified:false marks a request shape pinned from provider docs, not from a live call. A field absent from a case is not asserted.
